Message:
ethernet: use eth_hw_addr_set() instead of ether_addr_copy()

Convert Ethernet from ether_addr_copy() to eth_hw_addr_set():

  @@
  expression dev, np;
  @@
  - ether_addr_copy(dev->dev_addr, np)
  + eth_hw_addr_set(dev, np)
